goal: freeze the canonical runtime/build/control input identity as the Release Candidate only after all Phase 11 gates and the public Android version are certified
freeze_contract: each prerequisite completion artifact must report status=pass and the correct roadmap_step
each prerequisite certified commit must exist in full git history and be an ancestor of the candidate HEAD
ROADMAP_STATE must mark 11.1 through 11.9 complete
public Android version name/code must be frozen and pass release_version_identity_gate.py --release before 11.10 can pass
10.10 balance freeze must remain valid
11.8 zero blocker/critical gate must still pass
canonical data validation must pass
launch localization pack, terminology and linguistic gates must pass
11.1 regression matrix must pass on the candidate HEAD
11.6 overflow and iconography gates must pass on the candidate HEAD
11.7 audiovisual context must pass on the candidate HEAD
11.9 reliability soak must pass on the candidate HEAD
Godot 4.7.1 Linux binary must match its pinned official SHA-256 before execution
critical 11.10 and signed-AAB workflow Git blobs must match the fingerprinted release artifact contract
critical release-control scripts must participate in the release-input fingerprint
the workflow must finish with no repository diff
after all preceding gates pass, generate QA_11_10_RELEASE_INPUT_MANIFEST.json and record its aggregate SHA-256 in QA_11_10_COMPLETION.json
later evidence-only commits are acceptable downstream only if the certified head remains an ancestor and the complete runtime/build/control input fingerprint remains identical
any runtime, content, version, export preset, mobile contract, critical release-control script or pinned critical workflow change requires a new 11.10
a runnerless/unexecuted job cannot emit or justify QA_11_10_COMPLETION.json

release_input_evidence.aggregate_sha256: SHA-256 aggregate of certified runtime/build/control inputs

downstream_consumers: 12.6 signed release artifact lineage and fingerprint binding
note: This infrastructure is intentionally fail-closed. Preparing 11.10, freezing workflows or writing evidence tooling does not promote the roadmap step. The identity certified by 11.10 is the frozen public-version runtime/build/control fingerprint, not a mutable Play Console evidence commit.
